versions.reason: The accepted IR contract dev.lekalo.ir@0.1.0; the sole supported IR version.
The published target process protocol lekalo.target/v1 (dev.lekalo.protocol@1.0.0): process envelope, handshake, transport, and error classification for external target adapters (issue #27).

The additive describe-response extension (dev.lekalo.target-protocol@1.1.0, issue #28): declared IR contract versions, named capability support states, and optional declared constraints, negotiated by the probe-and-upgrade describe handshake while the 1.0.0 document keeps its exact published meaning.

The additive resolved-profile request extension (dev.lekalo.target-protocol@1.2.0, issue #29): operations that carry a target profile may carry its resolved capability snapshot and profile digest, so adapters receive negotiated capabilities instead of arbitrary YAML while the 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 documents keep their exact published meanings.
